verified_facts.claim: 2024 Indian election is the world's most expensive election in history
verified_facts.detail: CMS India Study estimates ₹1.35 lakh crore (~$16.5 billion) total spend — exceeding the US 2020 Presidential election ($14.4 billion). India's 2019 election ($8.6B) already surpassed the US 2016 election.
verified_facts.source: CMS India Study April 2024; Open Secrets US 2020 data

verified_facts.claim: Lok Sabha candidate spending limit is ₹75 lakh
verified_facts.detail: ECI revised limits in January 2022. Large state LS limit = ₹95 lakh. Smaller state/UT LS limit = ₹75 lakh. The old ₹70L limit was superseded.

verified_facts.claim: Political parties must disclose all donations above ₹20,000
verified_facts.detail: Under Section 29C of the Representation of the People Act 1951, parties must file contribution reports for donations above ₹20,000. Cash donations above ₹2,000 are prohibited under Section 13A of IT Act.
verified_facts.source: RPA 1951 Section 29C; Income Tax Act Section 13A

verified_facts.claim: 642 million people voted in 2024 — highest ever globally
verified_facts.detail: Approximately 64.2 crore (642 million) votes were cast in the 2024 Lok Sabha election at a 65.79% turnout. This is the highest number of votes cast in any election in human history.
